name: Soybean Crush Spread — Processing Margin
description: CBOT board crush spread: (ZM × 44/2000) + (ZL × 11/100) − (ZS/100). Shows the gross processing margin for soybean crushers — the value of meal + oil output minus the cost of raw soybeans. Three exhibits: crush margin over time with 1-year moving average, normalized component prices (ZS, ZM, ZL indexed to 100), and average crush margin by calendar month (seasonal pattern). Uses NoAdjustment for all three legs to preserve true cross-commodity price relationships.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush
# Formula: (ZM × 44/2000) + (ZL × 11/100) − (ZS/100)
# 44 lbs meal per bushel, 11 lbs oil per bushel
# Result in $/bushel of soybeans processed

# --- Data: Load all three legs via reference_futures ---
# NoAdjustment required for cross-commodity spread (D16)
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# ZS: cents/bushel, ZM: $/short ton, ZL: cents/lb
# Board crush: meal revenue + oil revenue − bean cost (all in $/bushel)
zs_close = ffill(zs.c)
zm_close = ffill(zm.c)
zl_close = ffill(zl.c)

crush = (zm_close * 44.0 / 2000.0) + (zl_close * 11.0 / 100.0) - (zs_close / 100.0)

# 252-day (1-year) moving average as trend reference
crush_ma = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(crush)

# --- Normalized Component Prices (indexed to 100) ---
zs_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(zs_close)
zm_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(zm_close)
zl_first = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(zl_close)

zs_norm = (zs_close / zs_first) * 100.0
zm_norm = (zm_close / zm_first) * 100.0
zl_norm = (zl_close / zl_first) * 100.0

# --- Seasonal: month extraction for bar chart ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Event Markers: Extreme crush levels ---
# High margin (>$2.00/bu) and low margin (<$0.50/bu) are notable
crush_high = is_valid(crush) and crush > 2.00
crush_low = is_valid(crush) and crush < 0.50

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Crush Margin',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush ($/bu)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Beans (c/bu)', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Meal ($/ton)', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='Oil (c/lb)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(crush, zs_close, zm_close, zl_close, crush_high or crush_low)

# --- Chart 1: Crush Spread Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Margin — Are Processors Making Money?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush, crush_ma))

# --- Chart 2: Component Prices (Normalized to 100) ---
xy_lines(
    title='What Is Driving the Margin? (Indexed to 100)',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='Index (Start = 100)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soybeans (ZS)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soy Meal (ZM)', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soy Oil (ZL)', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=100.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Start')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zs_norm, zm_norm, zl_norm))

# --- Chart 3: Seasonal Pattern — Average Crush by Month ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Seasonal Crush Margin — Which Months Are Best?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg $/bushel',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=crush, label=month_num)
